methods.label: Check the common-angle condition
methods.explanation: Both \(\angle 1\) and \(\angle 3\) are supplements of \(\angle 2\). Since supplements of the same angle are equal, \(\angle 1=\angle 3\). In the other choices, the sums of the angles differ or there is no common angle (or equal angles), so the conclusion cannot be drawn.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 property of equal supplements and checks whether each argument supplies its required conditions.
